intro.heading: Platform
intro.summary: Application initialization, event queue processing, and system services.
usage.heading: Typical usage
usage.paragraph: Call init() before creating windows and quit() when the app exits.
usage.title: Default driver
usage.paragraph2: With no arguments, Platform.init() prefers OpenGL. If your app does no rendering, pass GraphicsDriver.None.
methods.heading: Core methods
methods.row.init-preferred-supported.des: Initializes the platform and selects a graphics driver.
methods.row.pollEvent-target.description: Reads an event from the queue and returns a Bool.
methods.row.processEvents-onEvent.descri: Calls your handler for queued events.
methods.row.addEventWatchListener-listen: Registers an event watch. The callback can run on a different thread.
methods.row.delay-milliseconds.descripti: Sleeps for the given number of milliseconds.
methods.row.getTime.description: Returns the time as a Float.
